properties.description: Detects automated adversary scanners probing multiple honeypot sensors or targeting multiple distinct network ports across the DentiGrid deception mesh.
properties.query:
DENTIGRIDThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize DistinctPorts = dcount(DestinationPort_d), DistinctNodes = dcount(NodeID_s), TotalAttempts = count(), Signatures = make_set(Signature_s, 5) by SourceIP_s, SourceCountry_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where DistinctPorts >= 5 or TotalAttempts >= 20
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP_s
